title: Shinonome Ena — Turn Feelings Into Art〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm glad I went to the goldfish exhibit.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It was really hard trying to depict the water, but it made for great practice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: When I get home, I'll rework the composition and perspective since they didn't turn out so well.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll also fix the shadows...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If I want to convey the friendship of those goldfish, and how heartwarming it felt to watch them...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... It's probably better not to be too realistic with the reflections and lighting.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If I draw everything exactly as it was, the contrast between the light and dark spots will be too harsh.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I can try some different styles out as well once I get back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It sucks not walking home with a piece I'm satisfied with, but I'm edging forward, little by little. I just gotta do what I can.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have to remember what Mr. Yukihira said when I showed him my sketch.)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: A crucial part of refining your technique is how you visually convey to the viewer that which, usually, can only be understood by direct contact.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: The question of “how” one creates art begins with “what” one wishes to express with it.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: When the artist knows what they want to express, and then accomplishes this with rich use of composition and techniques that are appropriate or perhaps even innovative...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: That is what I believe to be good art.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: If you reattempt this exercise, I look forward to seeing your own original work. Not a reproduction.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Looking back, he was totally right.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No matter how good I get at depicting water, it doesn't mean anything if there's nothing I want to express with my piece.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: In that sense, I didn't do too badly today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The water looks so real. You can tell how slowly and gently they're swimming.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, you even captured that bit of warmth they have.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was nice to see, and I felt the same thing when I saw this picture.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what you mean! It's like you can feel so much kindness from these two, as if they're happy to be together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Of course, those two had already seen the actual goldfish, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They understood...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It really does feel nice when someone understands what you've tried to express.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If my illustrations for N25's songs can better convey what I have in mind, then...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Then maybe Kanade's music can reach more people.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: In that case, I need to work even harder.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Urgh, I already walked past the store I was gonna visit!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, whatever...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Since I'm feeling this motivated, I'll just head straight home and keep practicing art.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'll start by reattempting the composition and perspective. Then I can move on to rethinking the shading...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I sure have a lot to work on.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But if I can keep expanding my repertoire bit by bit...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If I want to get better, creating more art is all can do.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright! I need to get home and keep going!
